name: 3D-to-4D Voxel Expansion Algorithm
definition: An algorithm to expand a 3D voxel grid into a 4D object-centric representation by clustering voxels based on geometry, color, and dynamics.
summary: The 3D-to-4D Voxel Expansion Algorithm converts static 3D grids into 4D object-centric representations by clustering voxels via graph-based connected components using geometry, color, and dynamics.
